DiscountSurgical now accepts eligible Medicare insurance for compression garments on the LymphRx
website. Patients with lymphedema can use their Medicare Part B benefits when purchasing prescribed
compression products. This coverage includes compression sleeves, stockings, and related supplies
available through DiscountSurgical's LymphRx website

# What Medicare Now Covers

Medicare's new coverage includes:

✓ Compression stockings (various pressure levels) ✓ Compression sleeves for arms and legs ✓
Compression gloves and gauntlets ✓ Compression wraps and bandages

** ****Coverage Requirements:**
* You must have a qualifying medical condition diagnosed by a Medicare-enrolled physician
* Your doctor must prescribe the compression garments as medically necessary
* The garments must be supplied by a Medicare-approved provider
* Documentation must show that compression therapy is required for your specific condition

** **

**Coverage Requirements:**
* 3 compression garments per limb every 6 months

# Eligibility

To qualify for Medicare coverage under the Lymphedema Treatment Act, the following conditions must
be met:
* Lymphedema Diagnosis: A confirmed diagnosis of lymphedema, supported by appropriate medical
  documentation.
* Prescription for Compression Garments: A prescription from a qualified healthcare provider, such
  as a physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, or clinical nurse specialist. This
  prescription must be for compression garments or bandaging supplies specifically intended to treat
  lymphedema symptoms.
* Medicare Part B Enrollment: The individual must be enrolled in Medicare Part B, which covers
  durable medical equipment (DME) and related supplies.

# The Process
* **Schedule an appointment** with your healthcare provider to discuss your need for compression
  therapy
* **Get a prescription **or use our RX template that includes:
  * Your Lymphedema diagnosis
  * The type of compression garment recommended
  * The compression level needed (measured in mmHg)
  * How many garments are needed
  * How often they should be replaced
* **Call  Lymphrx.com** - a Medicare-approved supplier — to review your order
* **Submit your prescription **and Medicare information to us
* **Receive your compression garments** and begin experiencing the benefits!

## Travel & Everyday Wellbeing

Wearing medical compression garments is essential for a more comfortable and safer trip, especially
during long periods of sitting. Here are the key reasons to wear them when you travel:
* **Enhance All-Day Comfort:** Compression wear is designed to provide continuous support and
  comfort throughout your journey.
* **Reduce Serious Health Risks:** Specialized travel socks reduce the chance of developing travel
  thrombosis (blood clots), which can be caused by prolonged sitting in cars, trains, or planes.
* **Prevent Swelling and Discomfort:** The garments work to prevent mild to moderate symptoms, such
  as swelling and aches, that commonly occur during travel.

# who we are

[hope 4 healing]







Hope 4 Healing is a supplier of quality compression garments, wound care bandages/supplies and
mastectomy products.  We offer low prices and quality products to help you on your road to healing.



Patients with Lymphedema, Venous Insufficiency, and other vein diseases require bandaging supplies
and/or compression garments.  The bandaging supplies and garments, if used properly, keep swelling
under control and allow the patients to live a much more normal life. We offer top quality brands
for your lymphedema garments and/or medical compression garments and the most up to date products
available on the market.



Breast prosthesis (forms) and mastectomy bras are available.



Please contact us  for an appointment with one of our custom fitters. We will measure you for off
the shelf garments or custom garments, whichever you require.



You, our customer, are our top priority.  Our caring, experienced, compassionate staff will offer to
you, hope for healing.

### Lighten your trip. Start with your legs.

[Take off with TRAVENO][7]
[
][8]
[Read more][9]

## Step into color

Transform your compression stockings into a fashion and lifestyle statement with the new TREND
COLORS: effective compression therapy is combined with a trendy color selection that allows you to
emphasize your individuality.

[Discover TREND COLORS][10]

## Feel the natural effect

Discover our compression solutions with natural fibers for optimal comfort and not only benefit from
a light feeling in your legs thanks to compression, but also from the numerous benefits associated
with the use of natural cotton fibers.

[Read more][11]

### Color every moment

## Sigvaris flat knit in 5 vibrant colors

Explore our latest flat knitted compression garments in five unique colors across OPTIFORM HOLD,
FLEX, FEEL, and TOE CAPS.

[Discover now][12]

## Do the vein check now

Give your legs the attention they deserve and ensure a pain-free future on healthy legs.

[To the check][13]

## Medical compression solutions for you

Sigvaris compression solutions help you to go easily through your day. To feel strong and secure.
They give you the comfort to do everything you want, and they cater to your way of life.

[Read more][14]

## Compression stockings for all circumstances

Segment Essential

### Essential compression stockings - The all-round talents

Compression solutions from the Essential segment are designed for life situations where compression
stocking wearers, whether women or men, are looking for something uncomplicated. In this regard,
comfort and reliability are the top priorities. Essential stockings are the flexible everyday
companions, uncomplicated and yet visually appealing.
[Read more][15]
Segment Style

### Style compression stockings

Compression solutions from the Style segment are perfect for everyone for whom fashion aspects are
particularly important. They are always the right choice for those wish to make a fashionable,
self-confident appearance. No matter whether it's for leisure, special occasions or everyday work.
[Read more][16]
Segment Active

### Active compression stockings - For an active life

Compression stockings from the Active segment are suitable for people who are dependent on special
support in their dynamic lives. They are the ideal solution for all those who travel extensively,
like to move around a lot and are therefore looking for a stocking that always guarantees optimum
support. The special product properties of Active provide this security.
[Read more][17]


### How to avoid “economy class syndrome” while traveling

Anyone who travels long distances in a sitting position is at risk for leg complications. Wearing
compression socks or stockings can help prevent these problems and will greatly increase your
comfort along the way.
[Read more][18]

### Heavy legs

Are you asking yourself why your legs often feel heavy and uncomfortable? Discomfort of the legs,
like leg pain, heaviness, and/or leg tiredness, as well as swollen feet and ankles, can be first
signs of venous disorder. Medical compression can help.
[Read more][19]

## Your dedicated partner in lymphedema management

Absolute Medical, Inc. exists to provide support and guidance throughout the lymphedema management
process. We are experts at fitting compression garments, working with insurance companies, and
educating you on the best product for your needs.

### Our advocates come to you

We’ll meet patients for garment fittings in our Chicago office, at their lymphedema therapy
appointment, or wherever is most convenient.

[Learn More][50]

> “Great customer service greeting, took the time to go over the garments on display. They explained
> in depth when everything would come in and how to maintain the garments. I would recommend
> everyone to come here!! I am a Home Healthcare worker so I know great service when I see it.”
> 
> – Victoria C., Chicago, IL

### We work with most major health insurance

We’ll talk directly to insurance providers so that patients can feel confident knowing their
available benefits. We work with multiple top-quality insurance companies so let us know your
insurance information and we can check if your insurance is covered.

[Verify insurance][51]

### Our products

We feature the latest in circular & flat knit compression garments, pumps, and bandages for treating
all stages of lymphedema.

[See products][52]

Have questions? Reach out to us for answers.

## Proudly serving Ontario since 2014
## from Mississauga

[Medical Equipment Specialists]

**Medical Equipment Specialists**

Our Medical Equipment Specialists are experts when it comes to selecting medical equipment. Their
goal is to understand your needs and provide you with solutions tailored to your challenge to help
live more independently and comfortably. Each of ADAPT Home Health Care’s Medical Equipment
Specialists are specialized in a specific product category whether it’s Lymphedema, Compression,
Bracing or Mobility! With locations in Mississauga and in Brampton, book an appointment with one of
our Medical Equipment Specialists!

[Funding Options Available]

****Funding Options Available****

There are also numerous government programs available that people are often unaware of.  ADAPT Home
Health Care is a government approved vendor for different types of medical equipment including
mobility and lymphedema.  We are also an approved WSIB vendor and work closely with the March of
Dimes and the ODSP Program.  Most private insurance plans also provide third party coverage for all
of these product categories.  Our Medical Equipment Specialists will work with you to determine what
funding options might be available.  We will help you facilitate through the paperwork and
documentation to ensure you receive this funding in a timely manner.

## Meet Ami Hollis, CLT, BSN

## Certified Lymphedema Therapist | U.S. Air Force Veteran | Holistic Nurse Educator
##  
## As proud Lake Havasu City resident since 1973, I’ve dedicated my life to serving others—first in
## the United States Air Force during Operation Desert Storm, and later as a Registered Nurse right
## here in my hometown. My path has taken me through long-term care, hospice, public health, and
## private practice, but today, I’m proud to focus on lymphatic therapy as a Certified Lymphedema
## Therapist (CLT), helping my clients heal, recover, and thrive.
##  
## I earned my Bachelor of Science in Nursing from Northern Arizona University in 1998, where I was
## introduced to holistic nursing through a mentor who served as President of the Holistic Nursing
## Association. That experience shaped my core belief: healthcare is a partnership, and education is
## its most powerful tool. I believe that when clients are empowered with knowledge and given
## choices, they’re more likely to engage in their healing process—and that’s where real
## transformation begins.

[lymphatic_therapist_mohave_county.jpg]

### Military Service & a Personal Mission

During my Air Force service from 1988–1994, I had the honor of working alongside remarkable people,
including a fellow veteran whose battle with laryngeal cancer would change the trajectory of my
career. He introduced me to Manual Lymph Drainage (MLD) and Complete Decongestive Therapy (CDT), and
I saw firsthand how dramatically it improved his speech, swelling, and quality of life. His
therapist became his lifeline—and inspired me to become one, too.

 

That experience led me to pursue full Certified Lymphedema Therapist credentials through the Academy
of Lymphatic Studies. I’m continuing my advanced training and will earn my certification in Advanced
Lymphatic Management by December 2025.

### Passionate About Healing

My mission is to bring the power of lymphatic therapy to anyone who needs or wants it—from cancer
patients and surgical clients to athletes, migraine sufferers, and those managing chronic fatigue or
inflammation.

 

I offer gentle, evidence-based treatment plans tailored to:
* Cancer-related swelling & radiation recovery
* Post-surgical healing (cosmetic & orthopedic)
* Plastic surgery recovery (pre/post-op)
* Autoimmune-related swelling and chronic inflammation
* Headache & migraine relief
* Trauma & injury rehabilitation
* General wellness and immune support


As an Authorized Juzo® Retailer, I also provide:
* Custom compression garments
* Mastectomy bras and prosthetics
* Insurance billing for most major plans

### Serving My Community with Heart

From my earliest days volunteering at Smoketree Elementary to my involvement in Girl Scouts, 4-H,
NHS, and beyond, I’ve always believed in giving back to the community that raised me. Whether I’m
working one-on-one in my clinic, educating clients, or helping someone find the right garment for
their needs, my purpose is the same: to help people live with less pain, less swelling, and more
confidence.

 

Healing isn’t just about treatment—it’s about teamwork. And the most important member of that team
is you.

[Abstract Beige Texture]

> "Gentle touch, profound healing"

A Light Touch & Holistic Healing

### Compression Garment Retailer

A Light Touch Holistic Healing is proud to be an Authorized Retailer for Juzo®, a global leader in
medical compression therapy since 1912. Juzo's high-quality compression garments are designed to
improve circulation, reduce swelling, and support overall wellness. Their products are latex-free,
breathable, and available in a variety of styles and compression levels to meet individual needs. As
a Certified Lymphedema Therapist (CLT), Ami Hollis offers personalized fittings and guidance to help
clients select the appropriate Juzo® products for conditions such as lymphedema, venous
insufficiency, and post-surgical recovery. Explore our range of Juzo® products: Compression
Stockings & Socks: Ideal for managing tired legs, varicose veins, and chronic swelling. Arm Sleeves
& Gauntlets: Designed for upper extremity lymphedema management. Compression Wraps: Adjustable
solutions for various compression needs. Custom-Fit Garments: Tailored options for unique body

## Comprexx Fabric Advantage

# The fabric used in compression garments is carefully engineered to provide therapeutic benefits
# while ensuring compliance comfort, durability, and effectiveness. 

### Two Way Dimensional Stretch

Two-way dimensional stretch refers to the fabric's ability to stretch both horizontally and
vertically. This characteristic is essential for compression garments, as it allows the fabric to
move and conform to the body’s shape, providing a snug and supportive fit.

### Breathability

Compression garment fabrics are typically made from breathable materials that allow air circulation,
helping to regulate body temperature and prevent excessive sweating. This ensures comfort during
extended wear.

### Moisture-Wicking

The fabric is often moisture-wicking, which means it effectively draws sweat away from the skin to
the outer surface of the garment, where it can evaporate. This keeps the skin dry and reduces the
risk of skin irritation or infection.

### Softness and Comfort

Despite its strength, the fabric is soft to the touch, reducing the likelihood of chafing or
discomfort. The material is carefully chosen to ensure comfort, especially for those who need to
wear the garments for extended periods.

### Lightweight Design

Compression garments are often made from lightweight materials, ensuring that they do not add bulk
and can be worn discreetly under clothing.

### Hypoallergenic

The fabrics used are usually hypoallergenic, minimizing the risk of allergic reactions or skin
sensitivities, which is crucial for individuals with delicate or reactive skin.

### Easy Maintenance

These fabrics are typically easy to care for, being washable and quick-drying, making them
convenient for everyday use.

## Deep Plane Facelift Surgery in Sydney

Dr Scott Turner is a Specialist Plastic Surgeon in Sydney with a focus on facial aesthetic surgery,
including [deep plane facelift][160], neck lift, eyelid surgery and [facial fat transfer][161]. A
deep plane facelift is a structural facelift technique that works beneath the SMAS layer to release
retaining ligaments and reposition descended facial tissues as a composite unit.

This approach may be considered for suitable patients with midface descent, jowling, jawline laxity
and neck ageing. Dr Turner consults from Bondi Junction and Manly, with [facelift surgery][162]
performed in accredited Sydney private hospitals. Patients considering facial rejuvenation can learn
more about the procedure, recovery, risks, costs and suitability criteria on the dedicated deep
plane facelift page.

## Travel & Everyday Wellbeing

Wearing medical compression garments is essential for a more comfortable and safer trip, especially
during long periods of sitting. Here are the key reasons to wear them when you travel:
* **Enhance All-Day Comfort:** Compression wear is designed to provide continuous support and
  comfort throughout your journey.
* **Reduce Serious Health Risks:** Specialized travel socks reduce the chance of developing travel
  thrombosis (blood clots), which can be caused by prolonged sitting in cars, trains, or planes.
* **Prevent Swelling and Discomfort:** The garments work to prevent mild to moderate symptoms, such
  as swelling and aches, that commonly occur during travel.

# who we are

[hope 4 healing]







Hope 4 Healing is a supplier of quality compression garments, wound care bandages/supplies and
mastectomy products.  We offer low prices and quality products to help you on your road to healing.



Patients with Lymphedema, Venous Insufficiency, and other vein diseases require bandaging supplies
and/or compression garments.  The bandaging supplies and garments, if used properly, keep swelling
under control and allow the patients to live a much more normal life. We offer top quality brands
for your lymphedema garments and/or medical compression garments and the most up to date products
available on the market.



Breast prosthesis (forms) and mastectomy bras are available.



Please contact us  for an appointment with one of our custom fitters. We will measure you for off
the shelf garments or custom garments, whichever you require.



You, our customer, are our top priority.  Our caring, experienced, compassionate staff will offer to
you, hope for healing.

# Medigarments Ltd

## is a company that has built its reputation by producing outstanding quality medical products for
## over 40 years

Medigarments Ltd, is the company behind the inter­nati­onally recognised brands Jobskin^{®} and
SDO^{®}. We lead the way in rehabi­lita­tion therapy and are the largest UK manufacturer of specialist
bespoke compression garments supplied through therapy and orthotic profes­si­onals.

Our reputation for the design, and supply of technically advanced garments has been built over more
than 40 years supplying the highest quality made-to-measure products.

From our roots producing traditional corsetry in the 1950’s to complex structural medical garments
today, we are proud to say that 100% of our garments are still made in the UK.

Our products are used in the management of scarring as a result of burns or trauma injury, and in
the field of dynamic compression, where they are used to increase sensory and propri­ocep­tive
feedback as well as to provide muscu­los­ke­letal support. We are also one of only a handful of
companies still producing made-to-measure boned corsets.

# Medigarments Ltd

## is a company that has built its reputation by producing outstanding quality medical products for
## over 40 years

Medigarments Ltd, is the company behind the inter­nati­onally recognised brands Jobskin^{®} and
SDO^{®}. We lead the way in rehabi­lita­tion therapy and are the largest UK manufacturer of specialist
bespoke compression garments supplied through therapy and orthotic profes­si­onals.

Our reputation for the design, and supply of technically advanced garments has been built over more
than 40 years supplying the highest quality made-to-measure products.

From our roots producing traditional corsetry in the 1950’s to complex structural medical garments
today, we are proud to say that 100% of our garments are still made in the UK.

Our products are used in the management of scarring as a result of burns or trauma injury, and in
the field of dynamic compression, where they are used to increase sensory and propri­ocep­tive
feedback as well as to provide muscu­los­ke­letal support. We are also one of only a handful of
companies still producing made-to-measure boned corsets.

## Medical Compression Therapy for Poor Circulation, Lipedema & Lymphedema

[Poor circulation][63]. Graduated compression therapy can help manage symptoms such as tired achy
legs, swelling, spider veins, varicose veins, skin changes or leg ulcers by aiding your circulation.

[Lymphedema][64]. Compression garments are designed to comfortably keep pressure on the swollen or
affected area to assist the drainage of fluid and minimize swelling.

[Lipedema][65]. Compression stockings can help decrease pain and hypersensitivity, increase mobility
and minimize additional issues such as edema.

# Liposuction NYC: Redefine Your Shape and Reclaim Your Confidence

You’ve seen that familiar reflection in the mirror—one that doesn’t quite match the vision you hold
inside. It’s not that you haven’t tried every new boutique fitness class, every mindful eating
program, or every trick in the health magazines. It’s that some stubborn pockets of fat simply
refuse to budge. If this story resonates with you, you’re not alone—and more importantly, you’re not
without options. At the **Liposuction NYC Specialty Clinic**, we understand that the way you feel
about your body’s shape can influence every aspect of your life. Our mission is to help you close
the gap between who you are now and who you want to become.

The truth is, **liposuction** isn’t just about removing fat—it’s about revealing a more confident
version of yourself. It’s about finally slipping into that tailored suit or fitted dress and feeling
like you belong in it. It’s about turning heads for the right reasons—not because you’re hiding, but
because you’re standing taller, prouder, and freer than ever before.

## Understanding Liposuction: More Than Just Fat Removal

In its essence, **liposuction** is a surgical procedure that targets and removes excess fat cells to
sculpt your body’s natural contours. Commonly performed on the abdomen, thighs, arms, and back,
liposuction reduces unwanted bulges that remain, despite your best efforts with diet and exercise.
According to the American Society of Plastic Surgeons, liposuction consistently ranks among the top
cosmetic procedures in the United States, with thousands choosing it each year for effective,
lasting results.

But here’s the key point: Liposuction is not a “cheat code” for weight loss. Instead, think of it as
fine-tuning a musical instrument—you’re not composing a brand-new melody; you’re perfecting the one
that already exists inside you. That’s why candidates ideally maintain a stable weight and commit to
a healthy lifestyle both before and after the procedure. In short, liposuction sets the stage for
the real transformation: how you choose to celebrate and maintain your new form.

## Our Approach at Liposuction NYC Specialty Clinic: Artistry Meets Expertise

At our **Liposuction NYC Specialty Clinic**, your journey isn’t just a medical process; it’s a
carefully orchestrated experience designed to deliver life-changing results. We bring together a
multidisciplinary team of board-certified cosmetic surgeons, anesthesiologists, nurses, and patient
coordinators—each dedicated to ensuring you feel understood, supported, and cared for at every step.

**What sets us apart?** Think of our surgeons less as technicians and more as artists. They don’t
just remove fat; they sculpt harmonious proportions that respect your body’s natural curves. Using
the latest techniques—like **tumescent liposuction** or **laser-assisted liposuction
(SmartLipo)**—we minimize trauma to the tissues, reduce downtime, and optimize results. Our facility
is equipped with state-of-the-art technology and follows rigorous safety protocols, ensuring you
receive top-tier care in the heart of New York City.

## Customizing Your Procedure: The Consultation Process

The journey begins with a conversation. During your initial consultation, you’ll meet with a
seasoned surgeon who will guide you through the possibilities. We’ll ask about your goals, your
history, and the dreams you hold for your future self. Maybe you’ve been eyeing a sleeker silhouette
for your wedding day or seeking more proportionate contours after achieving significant weight loss.
Whatever your reason, we listen closely, because personalized care isn’t just a catchphrase—it’s the
foundation of everything we do.

DiscountSurgical now accepts eligible Medicare insurance for compression garments on the LymphRx
website. Patients with lymphedema can use their Medicare Part B benefits when purchasing prescribed
compression products. This coverage includes compression sleeves, stockings, and related supplies
available through DiscountSurgical's LymphRx website

# What Medicare Now Covers

Medicare's new coverage includes:

✓ Compression stockings (various pressure levels) ✓ Compression sleeves for arms and legs ✓
Compression gloves and gauntlets ✓ Compression wraps and bandages

** ****Coverage Requirements:**
* You must have a qualifying medical condition diagnosed by a Medicare-enrolled physician
* Your doctor must prescribe the compression garments as medically necessary
* The garments must be supplied by a Medicare-approved provider
* Documentation must show that compression therapy is required for your specific condition

** **

**Coverage Requirements:**
* 3 compression garments per limb every 6 months

# Eligibility

To qualify for Medicare coverage under the Lymphedema Treatment Act, the following conditions must
be met:
* Lymphedema Diagnosis: A confirmed diagnosis of lymphedema, supported by appropriate medical
  documentation.
* Prescription for Compression Garments: A prescription from a qualified healthcare provider, such
  as a physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, or clinical nurse specialist. This
  prescription must be for compression garments or bandaging supplies specifically intended to treat
  lymphedema symptoms.
* Medicare Part B Enrollment: The individual must be enrolled in Medicare Part B, which covers
  durable medical equipment (DME) and related supplies.

# The Process
* **Schedule an appointment** with your healthcare provider to discuss your need for compression
  therapy
* **Get a prescription **or use our RX template that includes:
  * Your Lymphedema diagnosis
  * The type of compression garment recommended
  * The compression level needed (measured in mmHg)
  * How many garments are needed
  * How often they should be replaced
* **Call  Lymphrx.com** - a Medicare-approved supplier — to review your order
* **Submit your prescription **and Medicare information to us
* **Receive your compression garments** and begin experiencing the benefits!

## The Recovery Journey
* 0-4 WEEKS POST-OP
  
  ### STEP 1
  
  Designed with adjustable closures and straps, our Step 1 compression garments provide support,
  comfort, and ease of use immediately following surgery.
  
  Studies show medical-grade compression may help **reduce swelling** and bruising, **protect the
  surgical site**, and improve tautness and **smoothness of the skin**.
  
  SHOP STEP 1 GARMENTS
* 4-12 WEEKS POST-OP
  
  ### STEP 2
  
  Once swelling reduces, patients will likely need a smaller size in their post-surgical garment.
  Our Step 2 products are designed with outward facing seams and no closures for comfortable wear
  under clothes.
  
  Medical-grade compression may continue to help **reduce swelling** and **improve comfort**.
  
  SHOP STEP 2 GARMENTS
* POST-RECOVERY
  
  ### STEP 3
  
  Made with Marena's proprietary TriFlex™ fabric technology, our Step 3 garments ensure maximum
  stretch and comfort for continued support after recovery.
  
  Studies show that targeted compression may help **reduce muscle soreness**, **counteract muscle
  fatigue**, and **prevent muscle cramps**.
  
  SHOP STEP 3 GARMENTS

### **We don’t need to twist your arm to see
### how our holistic approach to health & body
### can help you get back to your active lifestyle. **

Providing Osteopathy and Exercise Rehabilitation for all ages, our treatment approach is tailored to
your needs and combines injury diagnosis, prevention strategies, treatment and exercise
rehabilitation to help you manage your injuries. 

We consider your symptoms and diagnose your injuries by looking at the body as a whole and treat the
cause of your pain. We understand that all elements need to work in cohesion for an optimal level of
function and mobility.

Using a range of gentle treatment techniques, such as massage, trigger point therapy and
manipulation, we can assist you with a wide variety of musculoskeletal complaints such as, neck and
back pain, headaches and migraines, sporting injuries, reoccurring injuries, jaw pain, shoulder
pain, sciatica, scoliosis, arthritic pain and tendonitis.

At Victoria Sports and Rehabilitation Clinic, we treat people of all ages across their lifespan for
a variety of musculoskeletal complaints, this includes treatment [during and post pregnancy.][60]

Our clinic is in [Mount Eliza][61]. Appointments can be made [online][62] or you can call Mt Eliza –

Transform your compression stockings into a fashion and lifestyle statement with the new TREND

Discover our compression solutions with natural fibers for optimal comfort and not only benefit from

## Do the vein check now

[To the check][13]

## Medical compression solutions for you

Sigvaris compression solutions help you to go easily through your day. To feel strong and secure.
They give you the comfort to do everything you want, and they cater to your way of life.

[Read more][14]

## Compression stockings for all circumstances

Segment Essential

### Essential compression stockings - The all-round talents

Compression solutions from the Essential segment are designed for life situations where compression
stocking wearers, whether women or men, are looking for something uncomplicated. In this regard,
comfort and reliability are the top priorities. Essential stockings are the flexible everyday
companions, uncomplicated and yet visually appealing.
[Read more][15]
Segment Style

### Style compression stockings

Compression solutions from the Style segment are perfect for everyone for whom fashion aspects are
particularly important. They are always the right choice for those wish to make a fashionable,
self-confident appearance. No matter whether it's for leisure, special occasions or everyday work.
[Read more][16]
Segment Active

### Active compression stockings - For an active life

Compression stockings from the Active segment are suitable for people who are dependent on special
support in their dynamic lives. They are the ideal solution for all those who travel extensively,
like to move around a lot and are therefore looking for a stocking that always guarantees optimum
support. The special product properties of Active provide this security.
[Read more][17]


### How to avoid “economy class syndrome” while traveling

Anyone who travels long distances in a sitting position is at risk for leg complications. Wearing
compression socks or stockings can help prevent these problems and will greatly increase your
comfort along the way.
[Read more][18]

### Heavy legs

Are you asking yourself why your legs often feel heavy and uncomfortable? Discomfort of the legs,
like leg pain, heaviness, and/or leg tiredness, as well as swollen feet and ankles, can be first
signs of venous disorder. Medical compression can help.
[Read more][19]

support. The special product properties of Active provide this security.
[Read more][17]


### How to avoid “economy class syndrome” while traveling

Anyone who travels long distances in a sitting position is at risk for leg complications. Wearing
compression socks or stockings can help prevent these problems and will greatly increase your
comfort along the way.
[Read more][18]

### Heavy legs

Are you asking yourself why your legs often feel heavy and uncomfortable? Discomfort of the legs,
like leg pain, heaviness, and/or leg tiredness, as well as swollen feet and ankles, can be first
signs of venous disorder. Medical compression can help.
[Read more][19]

## Your dedicated partner in lymphedema management

Absolute Medical, Inc. exists to provide support and guidance throughout the lymphedema management
process. We are experts at fitting compression garments, working with insurance companies, and
educating you on the best product for your needs.

### Our advocates come to you

We’ll meet patients for garment fittings in our Chicago office, at their lymphedema therapy
appointment, or wherever is most convenient.

[Learn More][50]

> “Great customer service greeting, took the time to go over the garments on display. They explained
> in depth when everything would come in and how to maintain the garments. I would recommend
> everyone to come here!! I am a Home Healthcare worker so I know great service when I see it.”
> 
> – Victoria C., Chicago, IL

### We work with most major health insurance

We’ll talk directly to insurance providers so that patients can feel confident knowing their
available benefits. We work with multiple top-quality insurance companies so let us know your
insurance information and we can check if your insurance is covered.

[Verify insurance][51]

### Our products

We feature the latest in circular & flat knit compression garments, pumps, and bandages for treating
all stages of lymphedema.

[See products][52]

Have questions? Reach out to us for answers.

[Medical Equipment Specialists]

**Medical Equipment Specialists**

Our Medical Equipment Specialists are experts when it comes to selecting medical equipment. Their
goal is to understand your needs and provide you with solutions tailored to your challenge to help
live more independently and comfortably. Each of ADAPT Home Health Care’s Medical Equipment
Specialists are specialized in a specific product category whether it’s Lymphedema, Compression,
Bracing or Mobility! With locations in Mississauga and in Brampton, book an appointment with one of
our Medical Equipment Specialists!

[Funding Options Available]

****Funding Options Available****

There are also numerous government programs available that people are often unaware of.  ADAPT Home
Health Care is a government approved vendor for different types of medical equipment including
mobility and lymphedema.  We are also an approved WSIB vendor and work closely with the March of
Dimes and the ODSP Program.  Most private insurance plans also provide third party coverage for all
of these product categories.  Our Medical Equipment Specialists will work with you to determine what
funding options might be available.  We will help you facilitate through the paperwork and
documentation to ensure you receive this funding in a timely manner.

## Meet Ami Hollis, CLT, BSN

## Certified Lymphedema Therapist | U.S. Air Force Veteran | Holistic Nurse Educator
##  
## As proud Lake Havasu City resident since 1973, I’ve dedicated my life to serving others—first in
## the United States Air Force during Operation Desert Storm, and later as a Registered Nurse right
## here in my hometown. My path has taken me through long-term care, hospice, public health, and
## private practice, but today, I’m proud to focus on lymphatic therapy as a Certified Lymphedema
## Therapist (CLT), helping my clients heal, recover, and thrive.
##  
## I earned my Bachelor of Science in Nursing from Northern Arizona University in 1998, where I was
## introduced to holistic nursing through a mentor who served as President of the Holistic Nursing
## Association. That experience shaped my core belief: healthcare is a partnership, and education is
## its most powerful tool. I believe that when clients are empowered with knowledge and given
## choices, they’re more likely to engage in their healing process—and that’s where real
## transformation begins.

[lymphatic_therapist_mohave_county.jpg]

### Military Service & a Personal Mission

During my Air Force service from 1988–1994, I had the honor of working alongside remarkable people,
including a fellow veteran whose battle with laryngeal cancer would change the trajectory of my
career. He introduced me to Manual Lymph Drainage (MLD) and Complete Decongestive Therapy (CDT), and
I saw firsthand how dramatically it improved his speech, swelling, and quality of life. His
therapist became his lifeline—and inspired me to become one, too.

 

That experience led me to pursue full Certified Lymphedema Therapist credentials through the Academy
of Lymphatic Studies. I’m continuing my advanced training and will earn my certification in Advanced
Lymphatic Management by December 2025.

### Passionate About Healing

My mission is to bring the power of lymphatic therapy to anyone who needs or wants it—from cancer
patients and surgical clients to athletes, migraine sufferers, and those managing chronic fatigue or
inflammation.

 

I offer gentle, evidence-based treatment plans tailored to:
* Cancer-related swelling & radiation recovery
* Post-surgical healing (cosmetic & orthopedic)
* Plastic surgery recovery (pre/post-op)
* Autoimmune-related swelling and chronic inflammation
* Headache & migraine relief
* Trauma & injury rehabilitation
* General wellness and immune support


As an Authorized Juzo® Retailer, I also provide:
* Custom compression garments
* Mastectomy bras and prosthetics
* Insurance billing for most major plans

### Serving My Community with Heart

From my earliest days volunteering at Smoketree Elementary to my involvement in Girl Scouts, 4-H,
NHS, and beyond, I’ve always believed in giving back to the community that raised me. Whether I’m
working one-on-one in my clinic, educating clients, or helping someone find the right garment for
their needs, my purpose is the same: to help people live with less pain, less swelling, and more
confidence.

 

Healing isn’t just about treatment—it’s about teamwork. And the most important member of that team
is you.

[Abstract Beige Texture]

> "Gentle touch, profound healing"

A Light Touch & Holistic Healing

## Comprexx Fabric Advantage

# The fabric used in compression garments is carefully engineered to provide therapeutic benefits
# while ensuring compliance comfort, durability, and effectiveness. 

### Two Way Dimensional Stretch

Two-way dimensional stretch refers to the fabric's ability to stretch both horizontally and
vertically. This characteristic is essential for compression garments, as it allows the fabric to
move and conform to the body’s shape, providing a snug and supportive fit.

### Breathability

Compression garment fabrics are typically made from breathable materials that allow air circulation,
helping to regulate body temperature and prevent excessive sweating. This ensures comfort during
extended wear.

### Moisture-Wicking

The fabric is often moisture-wicking, which means it effectively draws sweat away from the skin to
the outer surface of the garment, where it can evaporate. This keeps the skin dry and reduces the
risk of skin irritation or infection.

### Softness and Comfort

Despite its strength, the fabric is soft to the touch, reducing the likelihood of chafing or
discomfort. The material is carefully chosen to ensure comfort, especially for those who need to
wear the garments for extended periods.

### Lightweight Design

Compression garments are often made from lightweight materials, ensuring that they do not add bulk
and can be worn discreetly under clothing.

### Hypoallergenic

The fabrics used are usually hypoallergenic, minimizing the risk of allergic reactions or skin
sensitivities, which is crucial for individuals with delicate or reactive skin.

### Easy Maintenance

These fabrics are typically easy to care for, being washable and quick-drying, making them
convenient for everyday use.

## Deep Plane Facelift Surgery in Sydney

Dr Scott Turner is a Specialist Plastic Surgeon in Sydney with a focus on facial aesthetic surgery,
including [deep plane facelift][160], neck lift, eyelid surgery and [facial fat transfer][161]. A
deep plane facelift is a structural facelift technique that works beneath the SMAS layer to release
retaining ligaments and reposition descended facial tissues as a composite unit.

This approach may be considered for suitable patients with midface descent, jowling, jawline laxity
and neck ageing. Dr Turner consults from Bondi Junction and Manly, with [facelift surgery][162]
performed in accredited Sydney private hospitals. Patients considering facial rejuvenation can learn
more about the procedure, recovery, risks, costs and suitability criteria on the dedicated deep
plane facelift page.

# Medigarments Ltd

## is a company that has built its reputation by producing outstanding quality medical products for
## over 40 years

Medigarments Ltd, is the company behind the inter­nati­onally recognised brands Jobskin^{®} and
SDO^{®}. We lead the way in rehabi­lita­tion therapy and are the largest UK manufacturer of specialist
bespoke compression garments supplied through therapy and orthotic profes­si­onals.

Our reputation for the design, and supply of technically advanced garments has been built over more
than 40 years supplying the highest quality made-to-measure products.

From our roots producing traditional corsetry in the 1950’s to complex structural medical garments
today, we are proud to say that 100% of our garments are still made in the UK.

Our products are used in the management of scarring as a result of burns or trauma injury, and in
the field of dynamic compression, where they are used to increase sensory and propri­ocep­tive
feedback as well as to provide muscu­los­ke­letal support. We are also one of only a handful of
companies still producing made-to-measure boned corsets.

Juzo designs all our medical compression garments to improve your life, not inhibit it. Family-owned
since 1912, we are a leader in the therapeutic compression garment industry. Our high-quality
products, including arm sleeves, socks & stockings, feature graduated compression to support you in

## Medical Compression Therapy for Poor Circulation, Lipedema & Lymphedema

[Poor circulation][63]. Graduated compression therapy can help manage symptoms such as tired achy
legs, swelling, spider veins, varicose veins, skin changes or leg ulcers by aiding your circulation.

[Lymphedema][64]. Compression garments are designed to comfortably keep pressure on the swollen or
affected area to assist the drainage of fluid and minimize swelling.

[Lipedema][65]. Compression stockings can help decrease pain and hypersensitivity, increase mobility
and minimize additional issues such as edema.

# Liposuction NYC: Redefine Your Shape and Reclaim Your Confidence

You’ve seen that familiar reflection in the mirror—one that doesn’t quite match the vision you hold
inside. It’s not that you haven’t tried every new boutique fitness class, every mindful eating
program, or every trick in the health magazines. It’s that some stubborn pockets of fat simply
refuse to budge. If this story resonates with you, you’re not alone—and more importantly, you’re not
without options. At the **Liposuction NYC Specialty Clinic**, we understand that the way you feel
about your body’s shape can influence every aspect of your life. Our mission is to help you close
the gap between who you are now and who you want to become.

The truth is, **liposuction** isn’t just about removing fat—it’s about revealing a more confident
version of yourself. It’s about finally slipping into that tailored suit or fitted dress and feeling
like you belong in it. It’s about turning heads for the right reasons—not because you’re hiding, but
because you’re standing taller, prouder, and freer than ever before.

## Understanding Liposuction: More Than Just Fat Removal

In its essence, **liposuction** is a surgical procedure that targets and removes excess fat cells to
sculpt your body’s natural contours. Commonly performed on the abdomen, thighs, arms, and back,
liposuction reduces unwanted bulges that remain, despite your best efforts with diet and exercise.
According to the American Society of Plastic Surgeons, liposuction consistently ranks among the top
cosmetic procedures in the United States, with thousands choosing it each year for effective,
lasting results.

But here’s the key point: Liposuction is not a “cheat code” for weight loss. Instead, think of it as
fine-tuning a musical instrument—you’re not composing a brand-new melody; you’re perfecting the one
that already exists inside you. That’s why candidates ideally maintain a stable weight and commit to
a healthy lifestyle both before and after the procedure. In short, liposuction sets the stage for
the real transformation: how you choose to celebrate and maintain your new form.

## Our Approach at Liposuction NYC Specialty Clinic: Artistry Meets Expertise

At our **Liposuction NYC Specialty Clinic**, your journey isn’t just a medical process; it’s a
carefully orchestrated experience designed to deliver life-changing results. We bring together a
multidisciplinary team of board-certified cosmetic surgeons, anesthesiologists, nurses, and patient
coordinators—each dedicated to ensuring you feel understood, supported, and cared for at every step.

**What sets us apart?** Think of our surgeons less as technicians and more as artists. They don’t
just remove fat; they sculpt harmonious proportions that respect your body’s natural curves. Using
the latest techniques—like **tumescent liposuction** or **laser-assisted liposuction
(SmartLipo)**—we minimize trauma to the tissues, reduce downtime, and optimize results. Our facility
is equipped with state-of-the-art technology and follows rigorous safety protocols, ensuring you
receive top-tier care in the heart of New York City.

seasoned surgeon who will guide you through the possibilities. We’ll ask about your goals, your
history, and the dreams you hold for your future self. Maybe you’ve been eyeing a sleeker silhouette
for your wedding day or seeking more proportionate contours after achieving significant weight loss.
Whatever your reason, we listen closely, because personalized care isn’t just a catchphrase—it’s the

MedCOR Professionals is dedicated to providing personalized and compassionate service. At our
medical supply store, you'll work with professionals who can handle:


* **Filing Medicare and insurance claims**

After you see a medical professional about your ailment, we can help you find the right supplies for
your recovery. We can even help file insurance claims.

[vendors][43] to find the products you need. We offer a generous return policy on most items to
ensure you are completely satisfied with your products.
* **Scheduling routine product delivery for your clinic**

Keep your clinic stocked with scheduled product delivery. We have the newest technologies at
competitive prices, so you'll always get the proper supplies and [equipment][44] for your facility.

uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and

make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions

Tytex helps healthcare brands and distributors develop and deliver medical garments and textile
solutions that healthcare professionals trust and patients prefer to wear.



With more than 50 years of experience, fully integrated European production, and deep regulatory
expertise, we are the trusted manufacturing partner behind some of the market’s leading healthcare
solutions.

textile products to market under your own brand. Our proven product development processes are
supported by experienced teams across R&D, Regulatory, Product Management, Customer Service, and
Quality Assurance. 



Built on more than 50 years of medical textile expertise, Tytex combines clinically trusted product
development with fully compliant European manufacturing and proven product platforms, helping you
launch differentiated healthcare solutions with confidence.



With ISO-certified production, full traceability, and compliance with global medical standards, you
can reduce complexity, accelerate time to market, and strengthen your healthcare brand with the
confidence of a reliable long-term partner behind you.

# let's build better healthcare together

Tytex helps healthcare brands and distributors develop and deliver medical garments and textile
solutions that healthcare professionals trust and patients prefer to wear.



With more than 50 years of experience, fully integrated European production, and deep regulatory
expertise, we are the trusted manufacturing partner behind some of the market’s leading healthcare
solutions.

[Let's talk][120][explore our portfolio][121]

## 

## Private Label partnerships

For private label partners, Tytex offers a fast and reliable way to bring high-quality medical
textile products to market under your own brand. Our proven product development processes are
supported by experienced teams across R&D, Regulatory, Product Management, Customer Service, and
Quality Assurance. 



Built on more than 50 years of medical textile expertise, Tytex combines clinically trusted product
development with fully compliant European manufacturing and proven product platforms, helping you
launch differentiated healthcare solutions with confidence.



With ISO-certified production, full traceability, and compliance with global medical standards, you
can reduce complexity, accelerate time to market, and strengthen your healthcare brand with the
confidence of a reliable long-term partner behind you.





[More about private label with tytex][122]

## 

## Distribute our established brands

For distributors and commercial partners, Tytex branded products offer a fast and reliable path to
market.



Built on decades of medical textile expertise and manufactured within our integrated European value
chain, our products combine regulatory confidence, clinical performance, and user comfort helping
you grow with solutions healthcare professionals trust and patients prefer to wear.



With products across eight therapy areas already developed, regulatory-ready, and supported by a
comprehensive marketing toolbox, Tytex enables you to launch faster, reduce complexity, and build a
stronger healthcare portfolio with confidence.









[more about brand distribution with tytex][123]

## WHY TYTEX?

### The European contract manufacturing partner in medical garments & textiles you can rely on



In regulated healthcare markets, reliability matters just as much as innovation.



Tytex combines decades of medical textile expertise with modern European manufacturing and deep
regulatory knowledge. We enable our partners to reduce complexity, accelerate development, and
deliver products users genuinely value. And we have done this more for than 5 decades.



What makes Tytex different is not only our ability to manufacture at scale. It is our understanding
of how medical garments and textiles need to perform in real clinical use: Comfort, fit, durability,
compliance, and patient acceptance.



#### Why partners choose Tytex
* Specialized exclusively in medical textiles 
* European production with full traceability 
* Strong regulatory and quality expertise 
* Proven ability to scale 
* Products designed for real-world healthcare use

### **We don’t need to twist your arm to see
### how our holistic approach to health & body
### can help you get back to your active lifestyle. **

Providing Osteopathy and Exercise Rehabilitation for all ages, our treatment approach is tailored to
your needs and combines injury diagnosis, prevention strategies, treatment and exercise
rehabilitation to help you manage your injuries. 

We consider your symptoms and diagnose your injuries by looking at the body as a whole and treat the
cause of your pain. We understand that all elements need to work in cohesion for an optimal level of
function and mobility.

Using a range of gentle treatment techniques, such as massage, trigger point therapy and
manipulation, we can assist you with a wide variety of musculoskeletal complaints such as, neck and
back pain, headaches and migraines, sporting injuries, reoccurring injuries, jaw pain, shoulder
pain, sciatica, scoliosis, arthritic pain and tendonitis.

At Victoria Sports and Rehabilitation Clinic, we treat people of all ages across their lifespan for
a variety of musculoskeletal complaints, this includes treatment [during and post pregnancy.][60]

Our clinic is in [Mount Eliza][61]. Appointments can be made [online][62] or you can call Mt Eliza –
